longTitle.officialTitle: To provide an extension of Federal-aid highway, highway safety, and transit programs, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Further Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021”.

section.heading: AMENDMENT TO THE EXTENSION END DATE.
section.content: Section 2(2) of the Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021 (Public Law 117-44) is amended by striking “October 31, 2021” and inserting “December 3, 2021”.

section.heading: AMENDMENT FOR FEDERAL EMPLOYEE COMPENSATION FOLLOWING HIGHWAY TRUST FUND EXPIRATION.
section.content:
Section 108(b) of the Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021 (Public Law 117-44)Ante, p. 386. is amended by striking “that begins” and all that follows through the period at the end and inserting the following:“that begins on—
“(1) October 1, 2021, and ends on or before the date of enactment of this Act; or
“(2) November 1, 2021, and ends on or before the date of enactment of the Further Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021.” .

section.heading: EXTENSION OF EXPENDITURE AUTHORITY FOR THE HIGHWAY TRUST FUND, SPORT FISH RESTORATION AND BOATING TRUST FUND, AND LEAKING UNDERGROUND STORAGE TANK TRUST FUND.

subsection.heading: Highway Trust Fund.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 9503 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsections (b)(6)(B), (c)(1), and (e)(3) by striking “November 1, 2021” and inserting “December 4, 2021”; and
by striking “Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021” each place it appears and inserting “Further Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021”.

subsection.heading: Sport Fish Restoration and Boating Trust Fund.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 9504 of such Code is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (b)(2) by striking “Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021” each place it appears and inserting “Further Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021”; and
in subsection (d)(2) by striking “November 1, 2021” and inserting “December 4, 2021”.

subsection.heading: Leaking Underground Storage Tank Trust Fund.—
subsection.content: Section 9508(e)(2) of such Code is amended by striking “November 1, 2021” and inserting “December 4, 2021”.

subsection.heading: Special Rule for Amendments.—
subsection.chapeau: On the date of enactment of H.R. 3684 (117th Congress)—

paragraph.content: subsections (a), (b), and (c) of this section, the amendments made by such subsections, section 201 of the Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021 (Public Law 117-44), and the amendments made by such section shall cease to be effective;

the text of the laws amended by subsections (a), (b), and (c) of this section and section 201 of the Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021 (Public Law 117-44) shall revert back so as to read as the text read on September 30, 2021; and
the amendments made by H.R. 3684 (117th Congress) shall be executed as if this section and section 201 of the Surface Transportation Extension Act had not been enacted.

subsection.heading: Conforming Amendment.—
subsection.content: Section 201 of the Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2021 (Public Law 117-44) is amended by striking subsection (d).

section.heading: PRIOR ENACTED AUTHORIZATION.
section.content: If H.R. 3684 (117th Congress) is enacted before the date of enactment of this Act, this Act shall not take effect and the provisions of this Act shall not be executed.
